easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Man-o'-War. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Man-o'-War trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat
